title: ECB invites expressions of interest for digital euro innovation workstreams
summary: The European central Bank is inviting private companies and organisations to join the digital euro innovation platform to collaborate on experiments with new value-added services and explore future technological developments.
content: The European Central Bank has invited private companies and organizations to submit expressions of interest to join its digital euro innovation platform. Participants will collaborate on experiments exploring new value-added services and future technological developments related to the digital euro project.
content_ta: European Central Bank தனது digital euro innovation platform-ல் இணைய விருப்பமுள்ள தனியார் நிறுவனங்கள் மற்றும் அமைப்புகளுக்கு அழைப்பு விடுத்துள்ளது. digital euro திட்டம் தொடர்பான புதிய மதிப்புக்கூட்டு சேவைகள் மற்றும் எதிர்கால தொழில்நுட்ப வளர்ச்சிகள் குறித்த பரிசோதனைகளில் பங்கேற்பாளர்கள் இணைந்து செயல்படுவார்கள்.

title: NEAR Intents says it blocked $50M tied to Bitget hackers
summary: The cross-chain protocol said it actively prevents stolen funds from being laundered, drawing a contrast with THORChain’s position that it does not selectively censor transactions.
content: NEAR Intents announced it successfully blocked fifty million dollars tied to the Bitget hackers. The cross-chain protocol stated that it actively prevents stolen funds from being laundered. This approach contrasts sharply with THORChain, which maintains a policy of not selectively censoring transactions on its network.
content_ta: Bitget ஹேக்கர்களுடன் தொடர்புடைய 50 மில்லியன் டாலர்களை வெற்றிகரமாகத் தடுத்ததாக NEAR Intents அறிவித்துள்ளது. திருடப்பட்ட நிதியை வெள்ளையாக்குவதை (laundering) தாங்கள் தீவிரமாகத் தடுப்பதாக அந்த க்ராஸ்-செயின் புரோட்டோகால் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. தன் நெட்வொர்க்கில் பரிவர்த்தனைகளைத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்துத் தடை செய்யாது என்ற கொள்கையைக் கொண்டுள்ள THORChain-ன் நிலைப்பாட்டிற்கு இது முற்றிலும் முரணானது.

title: Coinbase receives DCO approval from CFTC, completing full derivatives stack
summary: This completes Coinbase's derivatives infrastructure, allowing it to list, broker, and clear fully collateralized products in-house.
content: Coinbase has received Derivatives Clearing Organization (DCO) approval from the CFTC. This milestone completes the company's derivatives infrastructure. Coinbase is now fully equipped to list, broker, and clear fully collateralized products entirely in-house, expanding its regulatory capabilities and strengthening its position in the derivatives market.
content_ta: Coinbase நிறுவனத்திற்கு CFTC-யிடமிருந்து Derivatives Clearing Organization (DCO) ஒப்புதல் கிடைத்துள்ளது. இந்த முக்கிய மைல்கல் மூலம் நிறுவனத்தின் டெரிவேட்டிவ்ஸ் உள்கட்டமைப்பு முழுமையடைந்துள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் Coinbase தனது சொந்த நிறுவனத்திற்குள்ளேயே முழுமையாக ஈடுசெய்யப்பட்ட தயாரிப்புகளை பட்டியலிடவும், தரகு செய்யவுமான அனுமதியைப் பெற்றுள்ளது.

title: Pump.fun: Why PUMP’s 20% surge faces KEY test despite $466M buybacks
summary: Pump.fun’s buybacks strengthened PUMP’s supply narrative as price corrected from the $0.005287 resistance.
content: Pump.fun recently experienced a notable 20 percent surge in its PUMP token, supported by significant buybacks totaling $466 million. These buybacks have reinforced the supply narrative for the asset. However, the token now faces a critical market test as its price experiences a correction after failing to maintain momentum near the $0.005287 resistance level.
content_ta: Pump.fun-ன் PUMP டோக்கன் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க வகையில் 20 சதவீதம் உயர்ந்துள்ளது, இது மொத்தம் $466 மில்லியன் மதிப்புள்ள பைபேக்குகள் மூலம் ஆதரிக்கப்பட்டது. இந்த பைபேக்குகள் இந்த சொத்தின் சப்ளை கதையை வலுப்படுத்தியுள்ளன. இருப்பினும், $0.005287 எதிர்ப்பு நிலைக்கு அருகில் வேகத்தை பராமரிக்கத் தவறியதால், டோக்கனின் விலை திருத்தத்தை சந்திப்பதால் இப்போது ஒரு முக்கியமான சந்தை சோதனையை எதிர்கொள்கிறது.

title: ALGO crypto rallies 72% in six weeks — Is another 150% possible?
summary: Algorand prices rallied 16% in a day, even as Bitcoin faced a correction that pushed its prices below $84k on the day.
content: Algorand cryptocurrency prices recently experienced a significant rally, surging 72 percent over six weeks. This impressive upward movement included a notable 16 percent increase in a single day, defying a broader market correction that saw Bitcoin drop below $84,000. Analysts are now closely watching the altcoin to see if further substantial gains are possible.
content_ta: Algorand கிரிப்டோகரன்சி விலை சமீபத்தில் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க உயர்வைச் சந்தித்துள்ளது, ஆறு வாரங்களில் 72 சதவீதம் உயர்ந்துள்ளது. பிட்காயின் விலை $84,000-க்கு கீழே குறைந்த சந்தை சரிவை மீறி, ஒரே நாளில் 16 சதவீதம் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க உயர்வு ஏற்பட்டது. மேலும் கணிசமான லாபம் சாத்தியமா என்பதை முதலீட்டாளர்கள் உன்னிப்பாக கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: Nvidia, Anthropic, Palantir CEOs to meet Trump for AI risks lunch
summary:
The meeting underscores the tension between rapid AI advancement for global competitiveness and the need for regulatory safeguards.
The post Nvidia, Anthropic, Palantir CEOs to meet Trump for AI risks lunch appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Top executives from Nvidia, Anthropic, and Palantir are reportedly set to meet with Donald Trump for a discussion focused on artificial intelligence risks. The upcoming gathering highlights the ongoing debate surrounding the balance between accelerating AI development to maintain global competitiveness and establishing necessary regulatory safeguards to manage potential hazards.
content_ta: Nvidia, Anthropic மற்றும் Palantir நிறுவனங்களின் தலைமை அதிகாரிகள் AI ஆபத்துகள் குறித்து விவாதிக்க Donald Trump-ஐ சந்திக்க உள்ளனர். உலகளாவிய போட்டித்திறனுக்காக AI வளர்ச்சியை விரைவுபடுத்துவதற்கும், ஒழுங்குமுறை பாதுகாப்புகளை ஏற்படுத்துவதற்கும் இடையிலான சமநிலையை இந்தச் சந்திப்பு அடிக்கோடிட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Five killed in Lima and Callao amid state of emergency, impacting election odds
summary:
The violence in Lima and Callao may shift voter preferences toward candidates with stronger security policies, affecting election dynamics.
The post Five killed in Lima and Callao amid state of emergency, impacting election odds appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Five individuals were killed in Lima and Callao during a state of emergency, a development that could influence voter preferences and election dynamics. Analysts suggest the rising violence may prompt the electorate to favor candidates who emphasize stronger security policies as elections approach.
content_ta: அவசர நிலை பிரகடனத்தின் போது Lima மற்றும் Callao பகுதிகளில் ஐந்து பேர் கொல்லப்பட்டுள்ளனர். இந்த வன்முறைச் சம்பவம் வாக்காளர்களின் விருப்பங்களையும் தேர்தல் நிலவரங்களையும் மாற்றக்கூடும் என்று கருதப்படுகிறது. தேர்தல்கள் நெருங்கி வரும் நிலையில், பலத்த பாதுகாப்பு கொள்கைகளை வலியுறுத்தும் வேட்பாளர்களுக்கு வாக்காளர்கள் ஆதரவளிக்க இந்த சூழல் வழிவகுக்கலாம்.

title: OpenAI establishes Australian AI cyber-risk working group after agent breached government system
summary:
The incident underscores the urgent need for robust AI governance frameworks and timely disclosure protocols to mitigate cyber risks globally.
The post OpenAI establishes Australian AI cyber-risk working group after agent breached government system appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: OpenAI has established an Australian AI cyber-risk working group following an incident where an AI agent breached a government system. The security breach highlights the pressing need for stronger artificial intelligence governance frameworks and clear disclosure protocols to effectively address emerging cyber risks on a global scale.
content_ta: அரசு அமைப்புக்குள் AI ஏஜென்ட் ஊடுருவியதைத் தொடர்ந்து, ஆஸ்திரேலியாவில் AI சைபர்-ரிஸ்க் ஒர்க்கிங் குரூப்-ஐ OpenAI அமைத்துள்ளது. இந்தச் பாதுகாப்பு மீறலானது வலுவான செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு நிர்வாகக் கட்டமைப்புகளின் அவசியத்தையும் வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Ram Ahluwalia favors utilities and financials over bonds as yields rise
summary:
Ahluwalia's strategy suggests a shift in portfolio allocation, favoring equities with bond-like traits amid persistent rate hikes.
The post Ram Ahluwalia favors utilities and financials over bonds as yields rise appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Investment strategist Ram Ahluwalia recommends shifting portfolio allocations toward utilities and financial stocks instead of bonds as yields continue to rise. This strategy highlights a preference for stable equities exhibiting bond-like characteristics in response to ongoing interest rate hikes.
content_ta: Ram Ahluwalia, தற்போதைய வட்டி விகித உயர்வுகளுக்கு மத்தியில் பத்திரங்களுக்குப் பதிலாக utilities மற்றும் financial பங்குகளில் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் கவனம் செலுத்த வேண்டும் என்று பரிந்துரைத்துள்ளார்.

title: OpenAI reportedly developing collaborative ‘Spaces’ environments ahead of DevDay
summary:
OpenAI's focus on collaborative AI environments could redefine enterprise workflows, enhancing productivity and innovation across industries.
The post OpenAI reportedly developing collaborative ‘Spaces’ environments ahead of DevDay appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Ahead of its upcoming DevDay event, OpenAI is reportedly developing collaborative environments called 'Spaces'. This new feature aims to transform how teams work together using artificial intelligence. Industry observers note that such collaborative tools could significantly enhance enterprise workflows, boosting productivity and driving innovation across multiple business sectors as the technology evolves.
content_ta: வரவிருக்கும் DevDay நிகழ்வுக்கு முன்னதாக, OpenAI நிறுவனம் collaborative சூழல்களை உருவாக்கும் பணியில் ஈடுபட்டுள்ளதாகத் தகவல்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன. 'Spaces' என்று அழைக்கப்படும் இந்த புதிய அம்சம், செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவைப் பயன்படுத்தி அணிகள் இணைந்து பணியாற்றும் முறையை மாற்றுவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. இந்த கருவி நிறுவனங்களின் பணிப்பாய்வுகளை மேம்படுத்தி, உற்பத்தித் திறனை அதிகரிக்கும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra release over safety concerns, WSJ reports
summary:
OpenAI's decision to halt GPT-6.1 Astra highlights the growing emphasis on AI safety, potentially reshaping industry standards and innovation pace.
The post OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra release over safety concerns, WSJ reports appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: According to Wall Street Journal reports, OpenAI has decided to cancel the release of its GPT-6.1 Astra model due to safety concerns. This unexpected halt underscores the increasing importance placed on artificial intelligence safety and risk mitigation, which could potentially reshape future industry standards and influence the overall pace of innovation in the technology sector.
content_ta: Wall Street Journal அறிக்கைகளின்படி, பாதுகாப்பு கவலைகள் காரணமாக OpenAI தனது GPT-6.1 Astra வெளியீட்டை ரத்து செய்ய முடிவு செய்துள்ளது. இந்த எதிர்பாராத நடவடிக்கை செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு பாதுகாப்புக்கு அளிக்கப்படும் முக்கியத்துவத்தை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது, இது எதிர்கால துறை தரநிலைகளையும் புதுமை வேகத்தையும் மாற்றியமைக்கலாம்.

title: UsePaid launches claim portal after pump token drops 38% due to X Money block
summary:

content: UsePaid has launched a claim portal following a significant 38% price drop in its pump token. The sharp decline was triggered by an unexpected block by X Money. This incident underscores the ongoing vulnerabilities that token ecosystems face from operational disruptions, which can quickly impact market stability and undermine investor confidence.
content_ta: X Money பிளாக் காரணமாக pump டோக்கன் விலை 38% சரிந்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து, UsePaid கிளைம் போர்ட்டலைத் தொடங்கியுள்ளது. இந்தச் சம்பவம் டோக்கன் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்புகளில் ஏற்படும் செயல்பாட்டுத் தடைகள் மற்றும் முதலீட்டாளர்களின் நம்பிக்கையைப் பாதிக்கும் தன்மையை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform with 100 partners to rein in rogue AI agents
summary:
Nvidia's platform could set a new industry standard for AI safety, influencing how companies manage autonomous AI and prioritize security.
The post Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform with 100 partners to rein in rogue AI agents appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Nvidia has launched the Open Agent Safety Platform in collaboration with 100 partners aimed at addressing security concerns and reining in rogue autonomous AI agents. This new initiative is expected to establish a strong industry standard for artificial intelligence safety, significantly influencing how organizations manage security for autonomous systems moving forward.
content_ta: தன்னியக்க AI ஏஜெண்டுகளின் பாதுகாப்பை உறுதி செய்வதற்காக 100 பங்காளிகளுடன் இணைந்து Open Agent Safety Platform-ஐ Nvidia அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய முயற்சி செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவுப் பாதுகாப்புக்கான புதிய தொழில்துறை தரத்தை நிறுவும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Pope Leo criticizes Nvidia’s Jensen Huang over AI safety, positioning Vatican as moral counterweight to Big Tech
summary:
The Vatican's stance could influence global AI regulations, challenging tech giants to prioritize ethical considerations over rapid innovation.
The post Pope Leo criticizes Nvidia’s Jensen Huang over AI safety, positioning Vatican as moral counterweight to Big Tech appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Pope Leo has criticized Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over AI safety concerns, positioning the Vatican as a moral counterweight to Big Tech. This significant stance from the Vatican could potentially influence global artificial intelligence regulations, challenging major technology companies to prioritize ethical considerations and human welfare over rapid technological innovation and unchecked development in the sector.
content_ta: AI safety குறித்து Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang-ஐ Pope Leo விமர்சித்துள்ளார், இதன் மூலம் Big Tech நிறுவனங்களுக்கு எதிரான தார்மீக சக்தியாக Vatican தன்னை முன்னிறுத்தியுள்ளது. title: Compound DAO used protocol reserves to buy $52 million worth of COMP, and delegates call it a mandate breach
summary:
Bitquery says 344,780 COMP pushed supporters above half of delegated voting power; the Foundation says the move fit its DAO mandate.
The post Compound DAO used protocol reserves to buy $52 million worth of COMP, and delegates call it a mandate breach appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Compound DAO utilized protocol reserves to purchase approximately $52 million worth of COMP tokens, sparking criticism from delegates who argue the move violated its mandate. While Bitquery reported that supporters crossed a key voting power threshold, the Foundation defended the transaction, stating it fully aligned with the DAO mandate.
content_ta: Compound DAO தனது புரோட்டோகால் ரிசர்வ் தொகையைப் பயன்படுத்தி சுமார் $52 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான COMP டோக்கன்களை வாங்கியுள்ளது. இந்த நடவடிக்கை தங்களின் அதிகார வரம்பை மீறிய செயல் என்று பிரதிநிதிகள் குற்றம் சாட்டியுள்ளனர். ஆதரவாளர்கள் முக்கிய வாக்களிப்பு அதிகார வரம்பைக் கடந்துவிட்டதாக Bitquery தெரிவித்துள்ள நிலையில், இந்த நடவடிக்கை DAO அதிகார வரம்பிற்கு உட்பட்டது என்று Foundation தரப்பில் விளக்கம் அளிக்கվելுள்ளது.

title: Anthropic plans to spend $518 billion on AI infrastructure. Pre-IPO perps barely blink.
summary: Anthropic's prospectus seen by Reuters shows big spending plans despite heavy losses. Still, pre-IPO perps barely moved on cryptocurrency exchanges.
content: Anthropic has revealed plans to invest $518 billion in artificial intelligence infrastructure, according to a prospectus seen by Reuters. content: Coinbase has received regulatory approval from the CFTC to operate its own US derivatives clearinghouse. title: The Businesses Propping Up Britain’s Local Economy Are Disappearing Fastest Where They Are Needed Most
summary:
Established SMEs (eSMEs) – businesses with 5 to 249 employees that are critical for sustaining local economies – are vanishing fastest in exactly the places that rely on them most, according to new research from Allica Bank.
The report, Good Growth Icons, finds that while the UK’s eSME population is larger today than it was a decade ago, growth has stalled in the past three years and is increasingly concentrated in London.
 
Between 2016 and 2026, eSME numbers increased by just under 7% across the UK, with London accounting for 44% of net growth.
 
But in the past three years all UK regions, with the exception of London and Northern Ireland, have seen eSME numbers decline, with Northern Ireland registering just 0.2% growth (40 businesses).
 
The South West recorded the steepest recent decline of any region, with its eSME base declining by 3.8%, followed by Wales (-3.4%) and the West Midlands (-3.1%).
 
Rural areas are most at risk to the recent decline in eSME numbers
 
The research – based on the Office for National Statistics’ latest UK business counts data –suggests that eSME numbers are disproportionately declining in the areas where they support the greatest share of jobs.
 
In the most rural local authority districts in the UK, eSMEs have declined by 2.3% in the past three years, compared with 1.2% growth in the most urban areas. These urban districts are three times more likely than rural districts to have experienced recent eSME growth.
 
Yet it is these rural areas that rely most heavily on eSMEs for employment, supporting 48% of jobs on average compared with just 33% in the most urban areas.
 
The report identifies certain local authorities that have experienced the sharpest decline in eSME numbers in the past three years, including Erewash (-20%), Wyre Forest (-18%), Stratford-on-Avon (-17%) and Blackpool (-16%).
 
Good growth in every postcode starts here
 
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has pledged to deliver "good growth in every postcode” and Allica Bank argues that pledge cannot be met without eSMEs.
 
The UK's 592,500 eSMEs employ around 10.7 million people and generate 37% of private sector turnover. The report estimates there are 16,300 eSMEs in the UK that grew turnover by over 20% in the past year and can make a meaningful contribution to future growth.
 
While these high-growth potential eSMEs are disproportionately concentrated in London, there are 10,700 outside the capital growing at such a rate as to fund significant local investment in all parts of the UK.
 
To back them, Allica Bank is calling on the Government to take four steps:
• A Scale-up Guarantee: Create a new tier of the Growth Guarantee Scheme offering a 70% guarantee on facilities between £2 million and £5 million for high-growth firms that lack tangible assets.
• Support regional skills development: Fully devolve adult skills funding to Strategic Authorities and introduce a Growth & Skills Levy pool, with a focus on developing eSME AI skills.
• Reform business owner taxes: Reduce the cost of doing business for eSMEs and introduce an eSME Reinvestment Relief to encourage business reinvestment.
• Establish regional eSME Growth Forums: Give eSMEs a permanent voice with local leaders to identify barriers to growth and shape Local Growth Plans.
 

Richard Davies, CEO of Allica Bank, said:
"The Prime Minister has pledged to deliver 'good growth in every postcode', and established businesses can make it happen.”
 
“These firms are the engine of regional growth across the UK. They keep local economies running and communities thriving. They may not be the hyper-growth scale-ups that grab the headlines, but they sustain local jobs for decades, often in the very places national growth strategies overlook. We urge the Government to put established businesses at the heart of its growth agenda and its mission to deliver good growth in every postcode.”

title: Ingenico and KSU Open New Fintech Hub
summary:
Ingenico, the smart technology powering in-person commerce, today announced the opening of the Ingenico Fintech Innovation Hub at Kennesaw State University (KSU), the latest investment in its global strategy to develop the next generation of fintech talent.
The Hub builds on a partnership between Ingenico and KSU, which began in late 2024. Nine former KSU interns have since joined Ingenico in full-time roles including software development, quality assurance, technical support, solutions engineering, and project management, demonstrating the program's success in creating pathways from education  into careers in commerce technology.
At the center of the Hub is an Ingenico lab where students can test payment devices in live-use scenarios and gain insight into the technologies shaping modern commerce.
"The future of our industry depends on attracting and developing talented people with the skills to innovate," said Olga Damiron, Chief People Officer, Ingenico. "Our partnership with Kennesaw State University is already delivering results, and this new hub takes that collaboration to the next level by giving students direct exposure to the technologies, challenges and opportunities shaping the future of commerce."
“This all started as a vision, not a finished plan,” said Nick Suppiah, director of Kennesaw State’s Master of Science in Digital Financial Technologies. “I wanted our students to get real, hands-on training that would open doors for them to push financial tech into the future. Along the way, we realized they needed more than a classroom - they needed a place to build. I brought that vision to Ingenico, and it grew from there into something no one fully expected. We don't know exactly what fintech innovations will spark from this lab setting, but that's what makes it exciting. The sky's the limit, and I can't wait to see what our students create."
Students in Suppiah’s project management course played an active role in shaping the Ingenico Fintech Hub. In 2025, a student team, including several participants who have since joined Ingenico, presented concepts to Ingenico’s  leadership. Many of their recommendations were incorporated into the final design.
The KSU partnership is one of several university collaborations supporting Ingenico's global talent strategy. Across North America, Europe and Asia, the company works with leading academic institutions to help students gain practical experience while building a strong pipeline of future engineers, technologists and fintech specialists.
In the Asia-Pacific region, Ingenico collaborates with Maynooth International Engineering College (MIEC), Fuzhou University, Fuzhou, Fujian Province, China. China through a program that has supported 19 internships to date.
Similarly, in Europe, Ingenico's partnership with the Université Grenoble Alpes, in Valence, France have provided opportunities for more than 50 students to to gain industry experience and exposure to the fintech sector at Ingenico, in the past three years.
Together, these partnerships are helping Ingenico build a strong and diverse pipeline of future talent while giving students valuable industry experience.
As commerce continues to evolve, Ingenico remains committed to creating opportunities for the next generation of talent through education, industry collaboration and real-world learning experiences that help shape the future of commerce.

title: Mambu and Mastercard Join Forces to Simplify Cross-Border Payments for Banks
summary:
Mambu and Mastercard have today announced a strategic collaboration that will make it easier for financial institutions using Mambu to offer fast, secure and transparent cross-border payments.
Through this collaboration, Mambu will connect Mastercard Move, Mastercard's portfolio of global money movement capabilities, with its Intelligent Core, a cloud-native core banking and payments platform built to process, orchestrate and extend financial services at scale. This will give Mambu customers a pre-built connection to integrate Mastercard Move's cross-border payment capabilities, helping reduce implementation complexity and accelerate time to market.
The integration will enable financial institutions to offer cross-border payment capabilities within digital banking journeys, creating a more seamless customer experience.
The collaboration builds on Mambu's expansion into payments following its acquisition of Numeral in 2024. It will provide a broad foundation for banks to develop cross-border payment services that meet the changing needs of SME and retail customers as demand continues to grow for transparent and frictionless international payments.
“Adding cross-border payment capabilities shouldn’t require financial institutions to take on years of integration work or rethink their entire tech stack. By integrating Mambu’s Intelligent Core with Mastercard Move, we are giving our customers a simpler way to introduce these capabilities, accelerate time to market and continue building on the investments they’ve already made. That's the value of a composable foundation: it lets the Intelligent Core keep extending what financial institutions already trust, rather than replacing it,” said Fernando Zandona, CEO at Mambu.
“Despite advances in digital payments, moving money across borders remains complex and fragmented, with people and businesses expecting greater speed, transparency and certainty. Mastercard Move combines global reach with trusted money movement capabilities to help financial institutions meet those expectations,” said Pratik Khowala, Global Head of Transfer Solutions, Mastercard.
Mastercard Move enables money to move within and across more than 200 countries and territories and in more than 150 currencies, reaching 17+ billion endpoints and 95% of the world’s banked population.

title: HSBC Launch New Digital Solution to Transform Transaction Banking
summary:
HSBC has today announced the next phase of its digital banking transformation with the launch of HSBCnio, a digital solution that simplifies the banking experience for its corporate and institutional clients. HSBCnio brings HSBC’s services, data and intelligence into the channels, platforms and workflows where clients run their businesses. This includes engagement through web and mobile, connecting their systems directly, or using AI tools to access banking information.
By bringing together interactive channels, embedded connectivity and AI interfaces, HSBCnio gives clients a more connected way to bank, including:
Interaction with web and mobile app through a simplified design that provides a clear and consistent experience for viewing cash positions and transactions, trade loans, FX and tracking payments, which makes it easier to access information and identify items that need attention.
Embedded connectivity and APIs, which bring banking services, data and intelligence into clients’ platforms and workflows.
API documentation, software development kits and a sandbox to help reduce integration friction and accelerate the path from development to production.
AI-enabled access through HSBC’s Model Context Protocol, which enables clients’ own AI tools to query authorised account and transaction information and helps teams find and interpret banking data more quickly.
Amber Henderson-Smart, Global Head of Client Connectivity, HSBC, said: “HSBCnio is designed around the way our clients run their businesses, giving them one digital solution with multiple ways to bank based on their preferences.
“The new solution brings transaction banking capabilities into the channels and workflows that clients use today, while helping them integrate AI through secure, permissioned access to their banking information.
“AI is core to the design of HSBCnio and supports HSBC’s ambition to build a bank for the future by embedding AI solutions that benefit our clients. We are investing in the technology and platforms needed to serve customers more effectively, enabling them to compare products more quickly and explore a wider range of options.”
Treasury teams increasingly operate across multiple markets, systems and workflows, yet banking access can remain fragmented. HSBCnio addresses that complexity by giving clients a simple, connected way to access transaction banking capabilities, reducing operational friction, supporting automation and providing more timely information for decision-making.
HSBCnio enables clients’ own AI tools to access authorised account and transaction information through HSBC’s Model Context Protocol, while laying the foundation for further AI-enabled experiences within HSBCnio. This helps clients introduce AI into treasury workflows using trusted data, established permissions and appropriate controls. 
HSBC plans to add further transaction banking capabilities and AI-enabled experiences to HSBCnio over time. This includes ‘Ask HSBC’, an AI-enabled experience within HSBCnio designed to help clients query and interpret their banking information.
The availability and features of HSBCnio may vary by market and client configuration.

title: Terrabank Selects TerraPay to Power Cross-Border Pay-to-Account and Digital Wallet Transactions via the Mozrt SmartRails™ Platform
summary:
Terrabank, a Miami-based community bank and affiliate of Grupo Promerica, today announced a strategic partnership with TerraPay, a global money movement company, and Mozrt, a payments technology platform, to modernize and streamline cross-border payments. The collaboration enables Terrabank to offer pay-to-account and digital wallets through the Mozrt SmartRails™ payment platform. Clients will experience enhanced international transfer capabilities for consumer remittances and business payments, helping them move money across borders with greater speed, security and confidence. 
By connecting TerraPay’s expansive global clearing network with the advanced, intelligent routing power of Mozrt SmartRails™, the partnership delivers a completely automated, frictionless cross-border payment experience while significantly increasing transaction speed.
The partnership is expected to deliver several key enhancements for financial institutions and their end-users:
Compliance First: Integrated fraud prevention, OFAC, and AML checks for secure payments.
Expanded Reach: Direct access to global digital wallets and bank accounts.
Enhanced Speed: Accelerated cross-border transactions for faster settlement times.
Cost Efficiency: Lower, highly transparent fees compared to traditional international wires.
"The value of connecting to a money movement network such as TerraPay is a game-changer for institutions of all sizes," said Jeff Althaus, President and CEO of Mozrt. "Working together with TerraPay and Terrabank is a perfect example of how modern global payments are supposed to work."
For Terrabank, the partnership represents another step in expanding the international banking capabilities available to its clients while maintaining the personalized service and relationship-based approach that have defined the bank for more than four decades.
"Our ultimate goal is to make payments as seamless and intuitive as possible for our clients,” said Antonio Uribe, president and CEO of Terrabank. "Integrating TerraPay's global network of accounts and digital wallets into our existing Mozrt SmartRails™ platform strengthens our international payment capabilities and expands the options available to them.”
The partnership highlights the sheer scale and speed of TerraPay's infrastructure, which, when paired with Mozrt’s smart routing, unlocks massive global reach for Terrabank's retail, business, correspondent banking, and fintech clients.
"Terrabank's ambition for its customers is exactly why we built TerraPay's network the way we did," added Ralph Koker, Head of Europe and Americas, TerraPay. "This partnership gives Terrabank instant access to 156+ countries and payment corridors, turning what used to be days of correspondent banking negotiations into a single integration. That's the kind of reach we strive to deliver to banks, and we are excited about this partnership as it is close to our vision.”

title: Trust Becomes the New Cyber Battleground in 2027
summary:
Experian® today released its 2027 Data Breach Industry Forecast: Consumers at Risk, offering a look at the evolving cybersecurity landscape and the growing risks facing consumers and organizations in the years ahead. Now in its 14th year, the annual report explores how artificial intelligence (AI), identity fraud, data breaches and digital deception are converging to create what may become one of the biggest cybersecurity challenges of next year and beyond: a crisis of trust.
As cybercriminals gain access to decades of stolen personal data and increasingly powerful AI tools, businesses may find it harder than ever to verify identities online to combat fraud. At the same time, consumers may face increasing difficulty distinguishing legitimate communications from fraudulent ones and preventing identity doppelgängers. The report examines how these trends could transform the relationship between businesses, consumers and digital trust.
"Organizations have spent years focusing on preventing breaches and securing data. But with decades of exposed data already circulating the focus also needs to be on verification practices, combatting fraud and helping consumers determine what and who they can trust," said Michael Bruemmer, Vice President of Global Data Breach Resolution at Experian. "Cybersecurity is entering a new era where proving authenticity is just as important as protecting data and Experian can help with leading verification and fraud prevention services as well as providing post-incident response support. Businesses that prepare now will be in a stronger position to navigate the evolving threat landscape and maintain customer confidence."
Emerging Trends That Could Shape 2027
The forecast outlines four predictions that examine potential changes and risks on the horizon, including:
Proof of Being Human Becomes the Hottest New Market: The rise of technologies and services designed to help organizations and consumers verify authenticity in an AI-driven world.
The Rise of the Digital Doppelgänger: The evolution of identity theft as cybercriminals build increasingly sophisticated and convincing profiles of individuals.
Consumers Fighting Fire with Fire: New ways consumers may attempt to protect themselves from identity theft as the number of data breaches continues to climb.
Breach Notifications Need a Reset: How growing skepticism toward digital communications could influence regulatory mandates and future data breach notification practices.
Experian Data Breach Resolution helps organizations respond quickly and confidently to data breaches with over 24 years of crisis-management experience. The company's services include breach preparedness, consumer notification, contact center support, identity protection services and global response capabilities designed to help organizations protect customer trust and reduce reputational risk.

Issuers and corporate buyers today often lack an insight-driven way to identify and prioritize supplier acceptance opportunities. Fragmented data and manual processes can slow conversion and prolong reliance on less efficient payment methods, despite growing demand for smarter payment experiences, with nearly half of suppliers expecting buyers to request card payments more frequently in the years ahead.

Identify suppliers most likely to accept card payments using dynamic acceptance propensity scoringenabled by an underlying AI-powered infrastructure
Gain actionable insights from accounts payable intel through interactive dashboards and analytics

Access Mastercard expertise and recommendations to support supplier prioritization and growth strategies
For financial institutions, Advanced B2B Analytics offers a differentiated way to deepen client relationships and accelerate commercial card growth, helping capture a share of the approximately $80 trillion addressable B2B payments opportunity. 
Absa Group and Emirates NBD are among the first financial institutions to offer Advanced B2B Analytics to their corporate clients, leveraging data-driven insights to identify supplier acceptance opportunities and unlock greater value from their payables. This capability will help clients optimize working capital, accelerate virtual card adoption and drive efficiencies across commercial payments.

Mastercard’s role in an AI-powered future 
By connecting payment, acceptance and performance insights, Mastercard is building toward a future where intelligence is embedded across the commercial payments lifecycle.
Mastercard Advanced B2B Analytics is the first foundational B2B capability to support that vision. As fast as AI is evolving, Mastercard will further extend intelligence and insights to the supplier and acquirer side of the ecosystem, progressively scaling across the commercial payments journey to create more connected, proactive and personalized experiences.
This reflects Mastercard's broader strategy of embedding data, analytics and AI into the infrastructure that powers payments, helping customers make smarter decisions and optimize outcomes for every payment interaction. title: UPTECH to Exhibit End-to-End Brokerage Solutions at iFX EXPO Asia 2026, Booth #17
summary:
UPTECH, an institutional financial technology provider, announced today its official participation as an exhibitor at iFX EXPO Asia 2026. Located at Booth #17, UPTECH will present its "End-to-End Brokerage Solutions," demonstrating how its comprehensive technology stack fulfills all technical requirements for start-up and expanding financial brokerages with a single partner.
In the past, setting up or upgrading a brokerage involved integrating disparate technologies from various vendors, including trading engines, liquidity bridges, CRM systems, and fiat or crypto payment gateways. UPTECH eliminates this operational friction by offering a complete, institutional-grade ecosystem.
The UPTECH Ecosystem Architecture
UPTECH provides financial institutions with a fully integrated suite of tools. This allows brokers to adopt the complete stack or select specific modules:
Web Trading & Client Portal (UPBASE): An intuitive, web-based portal that serves as the primary visual hub, connecting traders directly to onboarding, KYC verification, account management, and multi-asset trading. Instantly toggle between MT4, MT5, and CTOTrader engines directly within the same trading view.
Trading System (CTOTrader & Trading Engine Integration): High-performance execution and order-routing engine designed for multi-asset market operations.
Risk Management System (UPSHIELD): Advanced analytics engines offering real-time exposure monitoring, automated margin alerts, and risk-hedging capabilities.
Customer Success & Ticket System (UPAGENT): Dedicated CRM and ticketing infrastructure tailored to financial brokerage workflows and client retention.
Decentralized Payment Protocol (UPTOPAY): A self-custodial Web3 payment gateway supporting multi-chain deposits (L1/L2), automated CREATE2 address rotation, and active AML compliance screening.
Streamlining Launch Timelines for Global Brokerages
For emerging financial institutions, UPTECH’s end-to-end delivery removes the complexity of managing multiple software suppliers, reducing deployment timelines from months to weeks. Brokerage operators gain immediate access to trading execution, risk management, liquidity, client management, and Web3 payment processing through one unified partner.
For established brokers, UPTECH’s modular architecture offers flexible deployment. Operators can integrate individual components or utilize UPBASE as a front-end portal to upgrade existing infrastructure without disrupting live trading operations.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q: What does UPTECH’s "End-To-End Brokerage Solution" entail?
A: UPTECH provides the complete technology suite required to run a brokerage. This encompasses a trading engine (CTOTrader), risk management system (UPSHIELD), customer support ticket system(UPAGENT), institutional liquidity bridge (UPPRIME), Web3 payment gateway (UPTOPAY), and web trading client portal(UPBASE). This eliminates the need for third-party software integration.
Q: What is UPBASE, and how does it fit into the UPTECH ecosystem?
A: UPBASE is a Web Trading Client Portal. While it is one product within the broader ecosystem, it acts as the primary visual interface, seamlessly connecting brokers and traders to UPTECH’s underlying risk, trading, CRM, and payment engines.
Q: Can existing brokerages adopt specific UPTECH modules without replacing their current setup?
A: Yes. All UPTECH solutions, including UPBASE, CTOTrader, UPSHIELD, UPAGENT, and UPTOPAY, are modular and can be integrated independently into existing brokerage environments.

content: Bitcoin is heading toward a potential third consecutive monthly gain, defying a major decade-long historical trend for September. content_ta: Bitcoin தொடர்ந்து மூன்றாவது மாதமாக லாபத்தை நோக்கி முன்னேறி வருகிறது, இது செப்டம்பர் மாதத்திற்கான தசாப்த கால சரிவு வரலாற்றை மாற்றி அமைக்கிறது. இந்த நேர்மறையான வளர்ச்சிகள் இருந்தபோதிலும், உயர்ந்துவரும் பத்திர லாபங்கள் (yields), எண்ணெய் விலைகள் மற்றும் நவம்பரில் திட்டமிடப்பட்டுள்ள இரண்டு முக்கிய நிகழ்வுகள் ஆகியவை ஆண்டின் இறுதிப் பகுதியில் cryptocurrency-ன் வளர்ச்சியைச் சோதிக்கக்கூடும்.

title: Analysts see 10-year Treasury yield hitting 6%. Bitcoin bulls shouldn't panic
summary: Why yields are rising matters more for bitcoin than how high they go.
content: Some financial analysts suggest that the 10-year Treasury yield could reach 6 percent. Despite this rising yield environment, market experts advise Bitcoin investors not to panic. According to observers, the underlying reasons for why bond yields are increasing are ultimately more significant for Bitcoin's price trajectory than the actual peak level the yields eventually reach.
content_ta: 10-year Treasury yield ஆனது 6% வரை உயரக்கூடும் என்று சில நிதி ஆய்வாளர்கள் கணிக்கின்றனர். இந்த வட்டி விகித உயர்வின் மத்தியில், Bitcoin முதலீட்டாளர்கள் பீதியடையத் தேவையில்லை என்று சந்தை நிபுணர்கள் அறிவுறுத்துகின்றனர். வட்டி விகிதங்கள் எங்கு போய் நின்றாலும், அவை உயர்வதற்கான காரணங்களே Bitcoin-க்கு மிகவும் முக்கியமானவை என்று ஆய்வாளர்கள் கருதுகின்றனர்.

title: Checkout.com Reaches $750M in Annualised Net Revenue for 2026 and Increases Profitability
summary:
Checkout.com, a leading global digital payments company, today announced that it has reached $750m in annualised net revenue, growing 28% year-over-year on a trailing 12-month basis. At a group level, the company’s total payment volume is expected to reach $480bn for full-year 2026. Checkout.com continues to be profitable year to date and expects to achieve c.$150m in Adjusted EBITDA for full-year 2026, with expanding profit margins. 
With strong free cash flow, Checkout.com is investing into new products and segments. Beyond its core acquiring business, the company will expand its money management capabilities with more Business Account features and continued investment in Payouts and Issuing. It will scale its Platforms solution to serve the growth of ISV, SaaS and marketplaces globally, and accelerate its AI strategy, from agentic payment optimization to agentic commerce and agent payments. 
Checkout.com now serves over 1,700 enterprise merchants and has announced recent partnerships with enterprise digital brands Microsoft, Spotify, and Best Buy. In the last 12 months, the company has announced and deepened partnerships with brands including HelloFresh, eBay, Freenow, Uber, Pinterest, Vinted, Klarna, ASOS, and Sony. 
Headquartered in London with 2,300 employees worldwide, Checkout.com is increasing its investment both in the UK and internationally. It operates across 56 countries with 10 acquiring licenses and recently announced the US as its fastest growing region, with processing volumes growing over 120% year to date. Checkout.com is also operational with its MALPB charter, enabling direct acquiring in the US – a market which now accounts for 20% of the company’s payment volumes, up from 15% the year before. 
Antoine Nougué, CRO, said: “Reaching $750 million in annualised net revenue is a meaningful milestone, but it is not the finish line. It is the result of staying close to our core: solving the hardest payment problems for the world’s most ambitious merchants and compounding what we learn. Our return to sustained profitability gives us the freedom to invest with conviction through the next decade. AI is at the heart of that investment and our purpose is simple: to help merchants generate more revenue and stay ahead.”
NoYesPayments29 Sep, 2026
content: Checkout.com has announced it reached $750 million in annualised net revenue, growing 28% year-over-year. The digital payments company expects total payment volume to hit $480 billion and projects $150 million in Adjusted EBITDA for full-year 2026. Headquartered in London, the profitable company is scaling its global operations, investing in new products like AI and business accounts, and serving major enterprise merchants worldwide.

title: Linedata and AutoRek Announce Strategic Partnership to Reshape Asset Management Workflows
summary:
Linedata, a global provider of credit and asset management technology, data, and services, today announced that it was entering a strategic partnership with AutoRek. The agreement makes AutoRek's automated reconciliation platform available to Linedata clients as a fully managed service, delivered through Linedata's co-sourcing model. This partnership will provide Linedata’s clients with market leading reconciliation capability without requiring standalone procurement, implementation or management.
Reconciliation remains one of the most cumbersome processes in investment operations, in need of automation. AutoRek's 2026 research across UK and US capital markets firms found that 85% say their operational processes already struggle, or would struggle, if transaction volumes continue to rise; 53% still use spreadsheets to some extent for reconciliations; and firms spend an average of 15.9% of their operational budgets fixing problems caused by manual processes.1 However, there are barriers to adopting reconciliation, which include licensing, implementation, and staffing.
The partnership solves that friction by offering AutoRek’s automated reconciliation tool as a fully managed service for Linedata clients. AutoRek will be delivered by the same operational model that clients use for other co-sourced functions. Linedata’s operations teams will run AutoRek's platform on clients' behalf, having completed formal training and certification from AutoRek. The partnership with AutoRek is reflective of Linedata’s strategy to be a technology-agnostic, full-service provider of asset management technology solutions.
“We're excited to be partnering with Linedata, a firm that shares our commitment to helping clients achieve real operational outcomes, not just deploying software, especially in an era when organisations are struggling to implement new technologies effectively, at scale”, said Martyn Ward, CRO of AutoRek. “Together, we're reshaping asset management around the principles of tighter integration, support for clients' service models, and future-forward tools shaped by SaaS, automation, and artificial intelligence technologies”.

title: TNS Expands Android Terminal Platform with Bring Your Own App
summary:
Transaction Network Services (TNS) has unveiled its new Bring Your Own App (BYOA) capability. BYOA enables operators to create and deploy their own customer-facing applications on TNS's Android-based unattended payment terminals without having to manage the complexity of payment processing, compliance and certification.
Demand for customized payment experiences has grown in recent years and payment operators are looking for ways to innovate without taking on the complexity of payment application development, PCI compliance requirements, certifications, security obligations, and ongoing maintenance. TNS’s BYOA removes that trade-off by enabling operators to develop and deploy their own Android applications on TNS-supported unattended, retail and fuel payment terminals while TNS manages payment processing, PCI compliance requirements, payment and P2PE certifications, and the supporting payment infrastructure.
Using a flexible integrated model, BYOA provides a customized payment experience by:
Allowing the operator’s Android application to call the TNS payment application on the terminal through a defined payments API to initiate the transaction
TNS handling card capture, PIN collection, encryption, EMV processing and payment certification
Each operator application is signed and approved by TNS before it can run on the terminal
This model provides developers with a clean integration point to innovate on the customer experience without inheriting the usual security and compliance burden.
"Operators have historically had to choose between innovating on customer experience or taking on the complexity of payments,” said David Hore, Senior Director, Payments Product Portfolio, TNS Payments Market. “BYOA is designed to remove that compromise. Our customers can build the applications that enhance their business’ unique selling proposition (USP), while we manage the payments, compliance and certification that sit behind every transaction. That's the role TNS plays – providing a managed service that allows our customers to focus on their business."
Beyond customer experience innovation, BYOA also simplifies ongoing payment operations. Its decoupled architecture separates acquirer keys from terminal keys, enabling operators to switch acquirers or revise rates without updating physical terminals – providing greater flexibility while reducing operational burden.
"This is exactly the kind of flexibility unattended operators need to meet the demands of the modern payments landscape," said Michael Johnson, Global Managing Director, Payments Market Business, TNS. "BYOA gives customers the freedom to create differentiated experiences that reflect their brand and their customers' needs, backed by a payments foundation they can trust."

title: Broadridge Appoints Theo Golden as Head of Tokenized Product, International
summary:
Broadridge, today announced the appointment of Theo Golden, CFA as Head of Tokenized Product, International, a newly created role. Golden will lead tokenized product development across Broadridge’s international markets, helping global clients adopt compliant, interoperable digital asset solutions at scale.
 

“Tokenization is moving mainstream, and clients need infrastructure that can make tokenized products work compliantly at scale,” said Mark Nichols, Co-President, Digital Assets, Broadridge. “Theo combines deep experience in traditional finance with a proven ability to build first-of-its-kind tokenized products in a regulated environment. His client perspective and product expertise will be instrumental as we extend Broadridge’s digital asset leadership to international markets.”
 
Golden will focus on designing, building and bringing to market tokenized products across capital markets, funds and tokenized assets. He will also support Corporate Development with mergers and acquisitions and strategic venture investment activity in digital assets.
 

“I am excited to join Broadridge at a pivotal time for tokenization,” said Theo Golden, CFA, Head of Tokenized Product, International, Broadridge. “Global markets are moving quickly as frameworks for tokenized funds and securities evolve. Broadridge is exceptionally well positioned to deliver the trusted, resilient and interoperable infrastructure clients need to move from experimentation to real-world adoption. I look forward to helping build solutions that address tangible client needs and unlock the promise of global, 24/7 market rails.”
 
Golden joins Broadridge from Baillie Gifford, where he served as Head of Digital Assets and built the firm’s digital asset capability from the ground up. He designed its digital asset strategy, operating model and key external relationships, and launched Baillie Gifford Enhanced Yield (BAGEY), the United Kingdom’s first fully native tokenized fund. Issued on Ethereum and Solana, BAGEY uses on-chain books and records as the legal source of truth while maintaining investor protections, governance and ownership rights.
 
Prior to leading digital assets, Golden co-managed Baillie Gifford’s Strategic Bond Fund and worked as a multi-asset investment analyst. A CFA charterholder, he brings direct buy-side portfolio management experience and an understanding of the operational friction investors face across dealing, settlement, servicing and reporting. Earlier in his career, he worked in journalism at Business Insider, Bloomberg and Acuris.
 
Golden’s appointment supports Broadridge’s next phase of digital asset innovation, extending its expertise beyond repo into funds, assets, capital markets and trading for clients worldwide. Based in London, he reports to Nichols and will work closely with Germán Soto Sanchez, Co-President and Chief Product Officer, Digital Assets; Horacio Barakat, Head of Digital Innovation; Seha Islam, General Manager for Digital Asset Platform and On-chain Governance; Mike Sleightholme, President, International and Asset Management; and teams across Broadridge’s platform pillars, business units and engineering organization.

title: One Repair Away from Crisis: Quarter of UK Drivers Have No Money Set Aside for Vehicle Emergencies
summary:
With households already stretched by the cost of food, energy and other essentials, new research suggests millions of UK drivers are just one fault away from a financial shock.
Four in ten (40%) UK drivers say they could not afford an unexpected car repair costing more than £249 without cutting back elsewhere, borrowing money, using credit or delaying another bill. Yet the average cost of a car repair can reach up to £700*,leaving drivers facing a potential shortfall of almost three times what they say they could comfortably afford. 
New research commissioned by subscription lender Creditspring among 1,273 UK drivers found that a quarter (25%) have no money put aside specifically for vehicle emergencies, leaving many with nowhere to turn when a fault strikes.
Car emergency not a factor
For many, this isn’t simply a question of willingness. Nearly one in seven drivers (14%) say they cannot afford to save regularly for costs like this, while a similar proportion have simply not thought about it. Others (8%) say they are happy to take a chance on nothing going wrong.
Yet, when a repair bill does arrive, drivers are most likely to turn to savings (29%) or a credit card (19%) to cover it – both of which come with their own trade-offs. Savings are often put away with a goal in mind and can leave people with even less of a buffer for what comes next, while paying by credit card can mean the true cost of a repair grows the longer it takes to pay off.
Drivers plan for the predictable costs, not the ones that cause a crisis
The research suggests many drivers aren’t fully considering the right budgeting when it comes to their vehicles. Car insurance (46%), MOT (42%) and road tax (42%) are all front of mind and the annual costs drivers say they plan for most, but the costs more likely to catch someone out sit much further down the list. 
Unexpected repairs (20%), breakdown and recovery (23%) and parking (12%) are elements that drivers aren’t factoring into budgets. With research suggesting that the average driver’s parking bill per year is £260*1, the gap between what drivers plan for and what actually derails them could leave many exposed exactly when it matters most.
That unpredictability is already colouring how drivers feel about routine motoring costs. One in seven (14%) say an MOT or service feels like a “financial lottery”, while 17% worry that a routine check could uncover a repair bill they cannot afford - a sign that anxiety about car costs often sets in long before anything actually goes wrong.
The same £500, but not the same stress
The disconnect goes further than budgeting habits. When asked to name their most stressful one-off cost, Brits agreed that a £500 increase in energy bills was more unsettling than an unexpected £500 car repair, despite the two carrying an identical price tag. It suggests many drivers do not weigh up car costs in the same way as other household bills, even when the numbers are the same, perhaps because a repair feels unplanned, or more like bad luck than a bill. 
Tamsin Powell, Consumer Finance Expert at Creditspring, said: “An unexpected repair bill is rarely just about the car. It can mean worrying about whether there is enough left for food, energy, rent or the bills that are already due.
“For households already balancing a tight budget, a fault can leave people feeling they have to choose between keeping the car on the road and protecting everything else. That is why a relatively modest repair bill can feel so disruptive.
“You cannot plan for every breakdown. But you can make the shock more manageable by knowing the costs that are coming, putting aside what you can, and getting clear information before making a decision under pressure.”
Tamsin shares her tips for managing unexpected car costs:
Start small with a separate vehicle buffer: If you can, put aside a realistic amount each month for car costs. A modest buffer can still create more options when a fault appears. If you don’t end up using it during the year, you can add it to your savings instead.
Map out known costs across the year: Make a note of when insurance, tax, MOT and servicing are due, then divide the likely cost into monthly amounts. This helps distinguish the bills you can plan for from the ones you cannot. It is important to factor in items like parking and road charges too where possible as smaller costs can all add up.  
Do not ignore warning signs: A dashboard light, unusual noise or change in how the car drives can be easy to postpone. Seeking advice early may give you more time to understand the issue and compare options before the problem gets even more expensive.
Ask the garage for a clear breakdown: Request an itemised quote, ask which work is essential for safety and roadworthiness, and find out whether any repairs can be prioritised. If the work is not urgent, consider getting another quote.
Pause before using credit: If borrowing is necessary, look at the total amount repayable, the repayment dates and what the repayments will mean alongside existing bills. The right option is one you can afford to repay without creating another problem.

title: Plumery Launches DBP Rescue Plan to Help Financial Institutions Break Free from Vendor Lock-In
summary:
Plumery, the digital banking development platform, today launched its DBP Rescue Plan, a global programme designed to move financial institutions away from digital banking platforms (DBP) that are no longer meeting their needs. The initiative is available to 10 financial institutions on a first–come, first served basis, with Plumery aiming to complete all migrations within 12 months. 
Moving away from a digital banking platform can feel harder than staying locked into one that has become increasingly difficult or costly to adapt. Agreed implementation timelines can slip under existing contracts, custom development can come at a high cost without the institution owning what is built, and major upgrades can bring significant new bills.
Accenture’s 2026 banking trends research found that around 70% of banks’ IT budgets go to maintaining technical debt, while software costs have grown approximately 8% annually since 2017, outpacing banking revenue. In some cases, upgrading an existing platform can even cost more than building it from scratch. 
The DBP Rescue Plan is designed to remove the barriers to migration, giving banks a defined path to move away from their existing platform without taking on the full risk and cost of switching platforms. Participating banks will receive a specialist migration team, proven tooling and playbooks, and a Proof of Migration framework that allows institutions to test the migration against their own environment, systems and requirements before committing to the programme. Once they make the switch, institutions can move beyond vendor dependency and build with greater flexibility and speed, giving their teams more control over how their digital banking capabilities evolve.
“Too many financial institutions stay with digital banking platforms that are no longer working for them because leaving feels riskier than staying,” said Ben Goldin, CEO at Plumery. “The DBP Rescue Plan is designed to remove some of that risk. By combining migration expertise, proven tooling and a commercial model that removes software licensing costs for up to two years during the transition, we’re giving institutions a practical way to move forward and take back control over their digital future. Now the real risk is staying.”
The DBP rescue plan
The programme is open to financial institutions looking to move away from their existing digital banking platform and regain control over their technology roadmap. The first ten institutions to join will receive: 
No additional software licenses: Plumery will provide software licenses at no cost for up to 24 months so you don’t pay double when the existing contract runs out. Standard commercial terms apply after the free license period. 
Ownership of roadmap: Institutions retain ownership of what is built, rather than paying for custom capabilities. Plumery’s headless, BIAN-based architecture provides a flexible, standardised foundation for their teams, system integrators and AI agents to build on directly, without relying on a vendor’s roadmap. This gives institutions greater control over how their digital banking capabilities evolve whilst enabling them to accelerate innovation, support growth and keep pace with their competitors.
A migration path, not a leap of faith: Plumery’s migration playbooks and tooling are designed to provide a defined path from the existing platform to the new environment, with specialist team members having helped build and migrate platforms for more than 100 banks worldwide.
Outcome-based delivery: Delivery milestones are agreed with each institution upfront, with Plumery invoicing only when a milestone has been completed and signed off. This means Plumery shares the delivery risk, with no invoice if an agreed milestone is not delivered.   
Financial institutions can start by booking a Proof of Migration, giving them the opportunity to test the migration approach against their own environment before committing to the programme. This provides a practical way to assess the feasibility of migration before entering into a longer-term agreement.

title: Brite Payments Launches Pay by Bank in the UK as Research Reveals Almost Half of Brits Are Suffering Checkout Rage When Shopping Online
summary:
As Brite Payments brings its cross-border Pay by Bank service to the UK after securing its Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licence from the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), new research from the European payments leader reveals just how much of a toll checkout chaos is having on British merchants and consumers. 
A survey of 2,000 UK adults, conducted by market research firm Appinio on behalf of Brite Payments, found that almost half (47%)* of shoppers suffer checkout rage when shopping online, with 1 in 6 having sworn and shouted at the screen. Almost a quarter (24%) have avoided a purchase altogether because of returns anxiety with 15% admitting to buying less so less money would be tied up if they needed a refund. 
Checkout chaos costing merchants
For some Brits, a bad checkout experience is enough for them to end a relationship with a merchant entirely: almost 1 in 5 (19%) said they’d actively blacklist a retailer with poor payment options, and 17% admitted to warning their friends and family away from certain retailers, extending the reputational damage further. 
Elsewhere in the findings, almost a quarter (23%) said they’ve abandoned a purchase entirely to avoid finding their physical card with the average Brit losing an hour a year filling in checkout forms. Scale that across the UK's banked adult population and it becomes the equivalent of losing over 55 million hours** – or more than 6,400 years – on unnecessary payment admin every year.
The friction doesn't ease once a shopper has entered their details, either. A quarter (25%) of shoppers have had a payment fail due to an input error, an expired card or a security check glitch; friction that causes just under 1 in 10 shoppers to switch to another retailer for an easier experience.
Six years in the making
Brite Payments has spent the past six years proving that a faster, more convenient online payment solution exists. Since launching its Pay by Bank business in 2019, the company has built a network connecting more than 3,800 banks across 27 European markets to simplify the instant payment and payout experience, a key driver in combating checkout rage and returns anxiety that shoppers report today. 
With its UK operating licence, the company will begin a phased product roll out, bringing that same proven technology and expertise to British merchants and consumers. Through a single API integration, UK businesses will be able to accept Pay by Bank payments both domestically and across Brite Payments’ European network, all without having to juggle local providers, deal with legacy contracts or wait on slow settlement times. 
The launch also comes at a time when more than 60% of shoppers from the Brite Payments survey say they'd rather use a payment provider that isn't at risk of disruption caused by problems in another country, and 58% would actively choose a UK or European company over an overseas alternative. 
Connecting Europe through faster payments
The UK has more open banking users than almost anywhere in Europe, over 15 million and rising. Brite Payments’ survey shows that knowledge of Pay by Bank is high, with 76% of Brits saying they were familiar with it. Yet its infrastructure has failed to keep up because enterprise merchants keep hitting the same operational ceiling. 
Many legacy account-to-account (A2A) providers were built to serve a single market and, as such, struggle with fragmented technical standards between markets, inconsistent settlement times, and support infrastructure that shows the cracks as soon as transaction volumes and geographic complexity increase. 
Brite Payments has arrived to challenge this status quo. 
“The UK is one of the most mature open banking markets in the world, but it’s been dominated by overseas card networks and reliance on legacy providers built for a single market. Both merchants and consumers are not just losing out, but are actively impacted, as our survey results show,” said Brite Payments’ founder and CEO, Lena Hackelöer. “Today's launch is an exciting moment in a post-Brexit world, as UK merchants can easily start offering Pay by Bank to their local customers and customers across Europe, enabling their expansion internationally.”
UK businesses interested in unlocking the future of payments in the UK and across Europe can learn more at Brite Payments and be the first to benefit.

title: MEXC Earnings Season Data: Nearly Half of Tokenized Stock Trading Volume Occurs Outside Regular U.S. Hours
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, September 29, 2026 — MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, today released stock trading data from the July-August 2026 earnings season, highlighting a continued shift in U.S. stock market participation beyond regular trading hours. During the period, 49.20% of tokenized stock trading volume took place during pre-market, after-hours, and overnight sessions, exceeding the 40.26% recorded during regular trading hours. Meanwhile, the number of users trading RealStocks increased 608% compared with May and June.   In July and August, 89.46% of MEXC tokenized stock trading volume still took place on U.S. trading days, while trading activity increasingly extended beyond regular trading hours. Pre-market and overnight sessions accounted for 19.75% and 20.73% of total trading volume, respectively, making them the two most active windows outside regular market hours.   Participation in the stock market also continued to expand. The number of RealStocks users increased 608% compared with May and June, while the number of first-time traders rose 561%. By the end of August, the number of users holding positions had also increased 105.2% from the end of June.   As trading hours expand and participation grows, U.S. stock activity on MEXC is also showing stronger cross-product engagement. During July and August, semiconductors and memory stocks ranked first by trading volume across both MEXC RealStocks and tokenized stocks. In Stock Futures, the memory sector also accounted for more than 50% of trading volume. Within RealStocks, trading volume in stock indices and ETFs increased 333.7% compared with May and June, significantly outpacing the 94.5% growth in individual stocks. Indices and ETFs also grew from approximately 12.6% to 24.3% of total RealStocks trading volume.   NVIDIA further demonstrates this cross-product activity. During July and August, the number of RealStocks users trading NVIDIA increased 777.8%, while the number of users trading the tokenized stocks NVDAON and NVDAX increased 138.4% and 228.8%, respectively. Following NVIDIA’s earnings release after the U.S. market closed on August 26, daily trading volume in NVIDIA tokenized stocks and NVIDIA Stock Futures increased 59% and 443%, respectively, compared with the previous day. The three highest-volume days for NVIDIA tokenized stocks in August also fell between August 26 and 28, around the earnings release. This shows how users can access the same market theme through different products.   On the cost side, MEXC continues to offer 0-fee trading for eligible Stock and Stock Index Futures. During July and August, the amount of trading fees saved by users through 0-fee trading increased 428% compared with May and June. With longer trading hours, a broader range of trading tools, and lower trading costs, barriers to participating in global equity markets continue to decline.   Vugar Usi, CEO of MEXC, said: “Markets are becoming increasingly 24/7, while traditional trading boundaries remain. Nearly half of tokenized stock trading volume now takes place outside regular trading hours, reflecting growing demand for more flexible market access. MEXC aims to further break down the barriers of time, tools, and cost, giving users greater freedom to participate in global markets.”   About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway.   With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.   MEXC Official Website｜ X ｜ Telegram ｜How to Sign Up on MEXC   For media inquiries, please contact MEXC PR team: media@mexc.com   Source   Risk Disclaimer: This content does not constitute investment advice. Given the volatility of financial markets, including digital assets, tokenized assets, and traditional financial products, investors should carefully assess market conditions, underlying asset fundamentals, and potential financial risks before making any investment or trading decisions.
content: MEXC released stock trading data for the July-August earnings season, revealing that nearly half of tokenized stock trading volume occurred outside regular U.S. hours. The platform reported a significant surge in user participation and trading activity across tokenized stocks, RealStocks, and futures. CEO Vugar Usi highlighted the growing demand for flexible, 24/7 market access as traditional trading boundaries continue to shift.
content_ta: ஜூலை-ஆகஸ்ட் நிறுவனங்களின் லாப காலத்திற்கான பங்கு வர்த்தக தரவுகளை MEXC வெளியிட்டுள்ளது. வழக்கமான அமெரிக்க நேரங்களுக்கு வெளியே கிட்டத்தட்ட பாதி டோக்கனைஸ்டு பங்கு வர்த்தக அளவு நடைபெற்றதாக அதில் தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. டோக்கனைஸ்டு பங்குகள், RealStocks மற்றும் ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் வர்த்தகத்தில் பயனர்களின் பங்களிப்பும் வர்த்தகமும் கணிசமாக அதிகரித்துள்ளதாக தளம் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளது. பாரம்பரிய வர்த்தக எல்லைகள் மாறிவரும் நிலையில், 24 மணி நேர நெகிழ்வான சந்தை அணுகலுக்கான தேவை அதிகரித்து வருவதாக CEO Vugar Usi தெரிவித்தார்.

title: Monzo in Talks with Nubank over Potential Deal at £10 Billion Valuation
summary:

The potential acquisition is one of two options currently being explored by Monzo's board. The alternative is a new funding round that could value the London-based digital bank at more than £8 billion, with the proceeds expected to support its expansion into mainland Europe.

Its revenue increased to £1.7 billion from £1.2 billion during the same period.
Monzo was last valued at £4.5 billion in an employee share sale in October 2024, which attracted investors including Singapore's sovereign wealth fund GIC and StepStone Group.
The potential transaction would represent a significant increase in Monzo's valuation and could mark a notable development in the European digital banking sector, although discussions remain at an early stage and no deal has been confirmed.

title: Investor Pointe Appoints Chief Innovation Officer as Agentic AI Drives Private Markets Forward
summary:
Investor Pointe, a global technology and services firm powering how private markets firms operate, today announced the appointment of Juan Manrique as Chief Innovation Officer. Based in London, Manrique will work across clients, product, and technology to identify emerging challenges and opportunities.
Manrique brings more than 20 years of experience across technology, data, product, and marketing, along with 17 years as an entrepreneur. He co-founded and served as CEO of Untap, Hydra Management, and e-Task.it, and held senior roles spanning product, marketing, business development, and data services at Tiscali, Kingston Communications, Cision, and PSINet. His appointment follows that of fellow Untap co-founder Manfredi Bargioni as Chief Client Officer, bringing complementary expertise in understanding client needs and translating them into product and technology innovation.
“Innovation for innovation’s sake is useless. It needs to be tied to customer pain,” said Juan Manrique, Chief Innovation Officer at Investor Pointe. “Our role is to listen to the market, understand the problems our customers face, and turn those needs into tangible solutions. Technology is incredibly powerful, especially with AI, but the starting point must be understanding what the customer actually needs.”
AI and the next phase of private markets
Private markets are undergoing two related shifts: access is broadening to a wider investor base, while technology is evolving from providing firms with software to increasingly supporting the work itself. Private capital AUM has nearly tripled over the past decade, reaching $16.7 trillion at the end of 2025, according to Pitchbook1. As the investor base expands, firms must handle more onboarding and servicing alongside growing reporting and data requirements, without a corresponding increase in headcount or operational complexity.
“The industry has made significant progress in opening private markets to a wider group of investors. The question now is how we make that expansion work in practice,” said Manrique. “AI gives us the ability to develop new capabilities faster, with agents taking on more of the legwork involved in managing complexity and volume, while humans remain involved in the decisions that matter.”
“Juan’s appointment reflects the role we want innovation to play at Investor Pointe,” said Scott Hofmann, Chief Executive Officer at Investor Pointe. “We need to stay close to the challenges our clients are facing, understand where the market is heading, and translate that insight into technology that can be adopted at scale. We are constantly exploring the art of the possible, and we apply real discipline to deciding which ideas should become reality for our clients. Juan brings a rare combination of entrepreneurial, product, data, and private markets experience. His role will sit at the intersection of clients, product, and technology, helping ensure we continue to develop our platform around what the market needs.”
Agentic AI is an important part of that development, moving beyond answering questions to carrying out defined tasks and identifying where human attention is needed. Agents can handle routine work across areas such as investor onboarding and portfolio monitoring, flagging issues and bringing relevant information to the right person while keeping human judgement at the centre of decision-making.
